mapper.sql: id, task_code, task_name, action_code, action_name, status, triggered_by, triggered_by_name, triggered_at, started_at, finished_at, heartbeat_at, log_content
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO manual_task_execution (task_code, task_name, action_code, action_name, status, triggered_by, triggered_by_name, triggered_at, log_content) VALUES (#{taskCode}, #{taskName}, #{actionCode}, #{actionName}, 'PENDING', #{triggeredBy}, #{triggeredByName}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), '')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manual_task_execution WHERE task_code = #{taskCode} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND deleted_at = 0
SELECT FROM manual_task_execution WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE manual_task_execution SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND deleted_at = 0
UPDATE manual_task_execution SET log_content = CONCAT(COALESCE(log_content, ''), #{content}), heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at = 0
UPDATE manual_task_execution SET status = #{status}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND deleted_at = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM manual_task_execution WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND heartbeat_at < #{before} AND deleted_at = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE manual_task_execution SET status = 'FAILED', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), log_content = CONCAT(COALESCE(log_content, ''), #{content}) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND heartbeat_at < #{before} AND deleted_at = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, display_name, real_name FROM sys_user WHERE deleted_at = 0 AND (real_name IN #{name} OR display_name IN #{name})
SELECT id, account_id, account_name, inventory_status FROM ad_account_asset WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND deleted_at = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, ad_account_asset_id, user_id, user_name, is_primary, assignment_status, assignment_source, application_id, assigned_at FROM ad_account_asset_assignment WHERE ad_account_asset_id = #{assetId} AND assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ad_account_asset_assignment (ad_account_asset_id, user_id, user_name, is_primary, assignment_status, assignment_source, application_id, assigned_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{adAccountAssetId}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{isPrimary}, 'ACTIVE', 'FEISHU_MANUAL_SYNC', NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE ad_account_asset SET inventory_status = 'ASSIGNED', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{assetId} AND deleted_at = 0
